'''Repulsor-droids''' were [[Water/Legends|water]]-proofed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dayark]]. [[Sal Olbeg]] used them to deliver drinks to guests at his [[Sal Olbeg's estate|estate]].
